test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21b40a460b5f78964b7bfc669c46594da36df8e7daf8af8ffcf85c2fc45a6bd3.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Middle arrow is rotated 45º in clockwise direction in every next figure.

2) Left bottom corner triangle is shifted towards right bottom corner of the next figure and rotated 90º degree in clockwise direction and turn into shaded portion, so on in the next figure.

3) Side half arrow is shifted one place to adjacent in the anti clockwise direction in every next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebf35012261d97176bda4e8d2c357de7e0782a1f90b723cf97dde945db332097.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
